# Prose Revision (h/t Anthony Lee Zhang)

license: `MIT` · 1 skills · last update: 2026-07-14

**Source:** <https://github.com/Gabberflast/prose-revision-skill-ht-anthony-lee-zhang>

**Maintainers:** Gabberflast (GitHub)

**Compatibility:** `claude-code` `agnostic`

> Single-skill repo distilling Anthony Lee Zhang's prose-revision guidance into a Claude Skill: structure-first revision on the principle of idea flow before linguistic flow. Diagnoses order, emphasis, and paragraph shape before smoothing sentences; aggressive on structure, conservative on content and claim strength; offers light / moderate / full-rebuild revision variants and says so when a draft already reads well. Explicitly positioned upstream of proofreading. Ships as a plain SKILL.md installable in claude.ai (Customize -> Skills) or Claude Code.


**Source YAML:** [`skills/prose-revision.yml`](https://github.com/bhanneke/RISE/blob/main/skills/prose-revision.yml)
